description: Class-conditional (Mondrian) split-conformal thresholds on the decision logit z of the hybrid pipeline in hybrid_weights.json. Parameters only.
score: z = decision logit of the pipeline (z > 0 = possible low oxygen); app/js computes it from hybrid_weights.json
method: mondrian split conformal, nonconformity 1 - p_y, finite-sample quantile ceil((n + 1)(1 - alpha)) / n per class, in the logit domain

states.LOW: Possible low oxygen: re-check with a pulse oximeter

rule.shortcut: normal if z < normal_below, possible low oxygen if z > low_above, unsure in between (equality has probability zero); past_crossing = true means alpha is so large that the middle band holds empty sets, not used

calibration.source: out-of-fold logits of the deployed pipeline on all six Hoffman people (scores/conformal_deployed_oof_hoffman.csv), leave-one-person-out meta-learner

nested_evaluation.note: Leave-one-person-out over the 6 Hoffman people, thresholds for each held-out person from the other five only, alpha = 0.1. deployed_pipeline_R is the pipeline in hybrid_weights.json (the model the app runs); its row is exploratory and optimistic because R was chosen with all six people in view. per_person_selected_hybrid is the nested estimate of the selection procedure. chain_only_control (the v1 logistic chain through the same conformal step, available in the app as ?engine=logistic) has the higher point estimates; all intervals overlap. Source: results/ml/conformal_curve.csv.

limits: Fit on six people with the Hoffman phones; windows overlap and people differ, so the coverage guarantee is approximate (see results/ml/CONFORMAL.md for the nested evaluation). Other phones are untested.
